paste BOTH signed self-contained installers here (after .NET Reactor + NutriculaSignInstaller) to build the Mac & Linux versions:
  Nutricula-32bit-SC.exe   (from workflow "2. Windows - 32bit (for Mac/Linux)", a zip you must
                            extract and run through .NET Reactor's Bundle feature first)
  Nutricula-64bit-SC.exe   (from workflow "3. Windows - 64bit (for Mac/Linux)", same as above)

(Nutricula-32bit.exe - the Windows installer - is not used by the Mac/Linux workflows. It goes
through ConfuserEx as before, not .NET Reactor.)
